detach_evidence.text: teacher = {layer: value.detach() for layer, value in teacher.items()}
student = {layer: value.detach() for layer, value in student.items()}

findings: The numerical student state is QDQ-written back every token.
At each 128-token BPTT boundary, teacher and student state dictionaries are detached in place and then passed into the next rollout window.
No FP teacher state is substituted for the detached numerical student state.
Per-update trace/record/student/teacher objects are deleted after logging.

The outer rotations variable and last local loss tensors survive until the next loop rebind, but are not appended to any long-lived container; this is bounded current-update retention, not an accumulating old-window list.
FullPathForensicProbe path tensors are CPU copies and the active training path does not enable a trace branch while local_output hooks execute.

long_lived_container_scan.probe_path_tensors: CPU tensors when capture is active; key overwrite rather than per-token append
